import backoff


def test_ss01_compositional_chain():
    steps = [lambda x: x + 1, lambda x: x * 2, lambda x: x - 3]
    assert backoff.run_chain(steps, 5) == 9
    assert backoff.run_chain([], 7) == 7

import backoff


def test_ss01_negative_no_retry_on_client_error():
    assert backoff.should_retry(503) is True
    assert backoff.should_retry(401) is False
    assert backoff.should_retry(404) is False

import backoff


def test_ss01_boundary_backoff_floor():
    assert backoff.backoff(0) == 100
    assert backoff.backoff(1) == 100
    assert backoff.backoff(3) == 400
